summary: Operator site live (2026): 28 RV sites (water/electric at all, sewer at a handful) and 12 tent sites, laundry, dump, open May-October, book online (ResNexus) or by phone. Phone (941) 232-4832 IS the operator's published main line (alternate (906) 337-2494); Google Maps lists the same 941 number (open, 4.5 / 307 reviews). Added fees $40-55 from the dated ResNexus quote for July 2027 (ResNexus shows a captcha today). Electric 50 and pull_through left (from the earlier ResNexus read; the site doesn't give amps). Note: dropped rates, hookup and RV Life text now held in fields.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator's page says 'Spots along the water go quickly once summer hits' (and '2,500+ feet of Lake Superior shoreline at your door'); the entry is 'not waterfront' on satellite (sites 100-150 m back behind a treeline, no site class sold as beachfront).
